composition_subtypes.role: Sort array to make optimal group contiguous
Use two-pointer window to maximize frequency with cost ≤ k

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array then use amortized two-pointer to find max length subarray where total increments to make all equal to right endpoint's value is ≤ k.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables greedy segment selection: optimal target sets are contiguous. Two-pointer efficiently maintains window within cost limit, exploiting monotonicity.
